title: EpiFlowML model input row (long-format CSV)
description: One row of the ingested CSV consumed by MeaslesDataLoader.prepData. ISO3 and date are required for the loader. depVar and predictors are experiment-specific; additional columns use additionalProperties. For column semantics and preprocessor rules see data_ingestion_pipeline/MODEL_INPUT_SCHEMA.md and model/input/PreprocessorConfig.csv.

ISO3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or geography code.

date.description: Calendar date for the row; monthly MS alignment recommended. Parsed in Python and renamed to ds.
